name: M2A3 Bradley, present day (tan, no tiles, TOW launcher raised)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'M2 Bradley': M2A2 6.55 m long, 3.28 m wide (3.61 m with tiles), 2.97 m high; 533 mm track, six road wheels, front drive, ground clearance 0.46 m

references.name: [D1] M2A2 port-side line drawing
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'M2BRADLEY.png' (866 x 434; the 960 px thumbnail is stored)
references.note: Bow LEFT, so flip. Scale 145.2 px a metre at 960 px from the six road-wheel centres (px 190, 298.5, 406.5, 546, 654, 760.5 -> 570.5 px over the 3.93 m from first to last wheel); it gives the nose at 3.26-3.28 m and the stern at -3.23..-3.30 m, i.e. 6.5 m, the published 6.55 m (two figures agree). Ground (track foot) at py 478, wheel centres at py 425 (z 0.365). X = (477.5 - px) / 145.2, Z = (478 - py) / 145.2. Kept not exact: it draws an M2A2 with the TOW launcher stowed and the ISU sight; this row is an A3 with the launcher raised and the CIV, so the turret top differs on purpose.

must_show: tall slab-sided hull, flat roof at z 1.95 from the stern (x -2.85) to the glacis knee at x 1.62, the long glacis down to the nose at x 3.26, z 1.0..1.22 [D1]

six road wheels at x +1.98, +1.23, +0.47, -0.46, -1.21, -1.95 with the wide gap behind the third (0.93 m against 0.75 m), tan discs with black rubber tyres, raised front sprocket at x 2.88 z 0.66 and rear idler at x -2.62 z 0.64, 533 mm track [D1; R2 2020 photo]

side armour standing over the track to a skirt line at z 0.72 from x -2.30 to 2.40, stepping up over the idler (x -2.42) and sweeping up over the sprocket (x 2.4..3.1), six panel joints, lifting loops on the lower panels [D1, Q1]
turret ring at x -0.45 (aft of mid-length), sloped turret front, roof at z 2.69, M242 25 mm on the gun axis z 2.40 reaching x 2.34 with the coaxial on its right (y -0.43) [D1]

twin TOW launcher on the turret's LEFT side, raised: rolled onto its side over the left of the turret roof (y +0.55..+1.17), x -1.87..-0.55, level to 3 deg nose down, belly z 2.85, top about 3.25 with the lid hump, two tube ends side by side facing forward, held by two posts and a spring strut under its front 40 per cent, the rear free [R2 2020 photo at 253 px/m; Q1]
four-tube M257 smoke clusters on both turret front corners, y +-0.84, x 0.33..0.63 [D1, Q1]

A3: the IBAS gunner's sight head on the roof front left of the gun (x -0.39..0.17, y -0.11..0.29, top z 3.05) and the commander's independent viewer drum on the right rear (x -1.09, y -0.91, top z 3.25) [R2, R5]
headlamp pairs in guards on both nose corners (x 3.02..3.20, y +-1.39), the louvred intake on the right glacis (y -0.72) and the exhaust grille on the right shoulder (x 0.48..1.48) [P1, Q1]
stern: the ramp between the two rear corner boxes (x -2.85..-3.25), the raised rear cargo hatch on the roof (x -2.80..-2.10, z 2.09) [D1, P2]
bolt heads only on the side armour, glacis applique and turret sides, column pairs on the panel joints (x -1.98, -1.17, -0.36, 0.45, 1.26, 2.07) and rows at z 0.80..1.76 [Q1, D1]

plain tan paint, no camouflage, numbers or markings; team colour in two roof strips beside the cargo hatch (x -2.74..-2.16, y +-0.70..1.00, z 1.96) and the gunner's hatch lid (x -0.83, y +0.17, z 2.76)

not_confirmed: the turret ring's side offset: no top view; drawn 0.25 m to the right so the turret and its TOW box sit centred as head-on photographs show

the raised TOW launcher: R2 (Combined Resolve XIII, 2020, 253 px a metre off the wheel hubs) shows the box level or about 3 deg nose down, belly z about 2.85, top about 3.25 with the lid, 0.40-0.45 m deep, carried under its front 40 per cent with the rear unsupported; Q1 shows it rolled onto its side with the tubes side by side. Drawn so (-1.7 deg, 0.38 m deep); the arm's linkage (two posts and a spring strut from a bracket on the turret side) is simplified
the CIV head's shape (drawn as a drum and a box head) and the IBAS head's door layout
the return rollers (hidden by the skirt, three drawn) and the roof hatch outlines
the two lifting loops at the turret front top (Q1) and the engine access plate outline on the right front roof: stations by eye
